comment: Guards run against every pull request. Severity lives here rather than in
the workflow so that promoting a guard from advisory to hard — or demoting
one that turns out to be noisy — is a one-line edit reviewed like any other
change, not a rewrite of CI.
mode: hard      failing this guard fails the job.
mode: advisory  failing is reported and the job still passes.

guards.description: The pull request references an issue.
The diff is at most 300 lines, excluding lockfiles and vendored data.
Added lines, commit messages and the pull request text avoid the register of unreviewed prose.
